recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future Permission search-parameter changes should be made in HL7/data-access-policies unless Permission is reintroduced as an active core resource.
issue_request: FHIR-50221 is an Applied/Persuasive Security WG R6 change request to add a Permission search parameter for Permission.rule.data.resource.reference so servers can find Permissions that reference a specific data resource such as a List.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3522 merged on 2025-07-03 while Permission was still in core. Commit e35c6b3ba4e1b2de2e6d30e17f3fe78feb4e706a added Permission-rule-data-resource to source/permission/bundle-Permission-search-params.xml, and commit 0c4d08d0b8f884a863c3a48bc993439535f1ca32 corrected its code to rule-data-resource while preserving expression Permission.rule.data.resource.reference.
additional_context: Commit 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3 later removed source/permission and the active Permission entries from core. Current core source/fhir.ini has no active Permission resource, and core narrative links Permission to the HL7 Data Access Policies IG. The current HL7/data-access-policies search-parameter bundle contains Permission-rule-data-resource. Companion issue FHIR-50222 is already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because Permission's current source of truth is outside this FHIR core checkout and already carries the requested search parameter.
